title: Show and Tell
description:
Do you have something you want to show off? Now is your chance!

It can be a piece of pottery you are working on, a wood project that you are building, a program that you wrote, something you cut on the laser cutter, or an object printed on the 3D printers.

**If you made it at the Makerspace, we would like to see it.**

Want to let us know what you are bringing? Feel free to direct questions to:  
[events@melbournemakerspace.org](mailto:events@melbournemakerspace.org)
